body:
Went through each audiostream type and what they return for this:

- AudioStreamWAV, AudioStreamOggVorbis, AudioStreamMP3 - normal
- AudioStreamPlaylist - basically normal - returns length of entire playlist
- AudioStreamSynchronized - basically normal - returns max length of clips (since all clips play at once)
- AudioStreamGenerator - indeterminate, returns 0
- AudioStreamInteractive - indeterminate, returns 0
- AudioStreamMicrophone - indeterminate, returns 0
- AudioStreamPolyphonic - returns 0, could be playing multiple things at once so doesn't make sense to return one length
- AudioStreamRandomizer - returns length of last played stream

So the randomizer is the only stream that behaves this way so far, but I can see this misleading people into thinking playlist behaves this way... so it might be better to call out its behavior specifically:

```Returns the length of the audio stream in seconds. For [AudioStreamRandomizer], returns the length of the last played stream. If this stream has an indefinite length (such as for [AudioStreamGenerator] and [AudioStreamMicrophone]), returns [code]0.0[/code].```
